Fifteen complete blocks, all 54 footnotes and full bibliography independently read. Incoming Memoranda for Mr Darwin, supplied September 22 solely from later Darwin abstract label Extract from Blyth letter of Sept22d1855; no exact receipt timestamp. P6 species-name blank after C. is intentional missing text; do not silently insert modern footnote identification. P7–10 Blyth instinct/reason claims, social assumptions, recommended Darwin treatment and reported anecdotes; presumed agreement is not proof Darwin agreed. P8 marginal Possum/Gum-trees insertion authorial with editorial position, not new source or accurately established geography. P11 assumes Darwin read two Australian works, which does not itself establish access; Strzelecki claim described as confuted, not affirmed. Quoted/recollected observations and authorial uncertain references stay qualified. P12 doubts feral fowl/fancy pigeons and challenges climatic explanation of pullets, not a demonstrated universal result. P13 wild pig skull/species and fertile-cross hypotheses; P14 husbandry, milk, sheep, horses, insect domestication, elephant variation and introduced plants. Distinguishes races from intentionally produced breeds; Darwin later abstract twice asks Why, so do not assign Blyth distinction to Darwin. Apparatus quotes pieces of six-page Darwin abstract without giving complete prose or its date. Bibliographic ownership, earlier notebook reading, later annotations and recommendations are distinct from demonstrated September knowledge.
